title: smtp/server.rs: no-op smtps_parts rebind
description:
Why this issue exists: In crates/smtp/src/server.rs, there is a let smtps_parts: Option<...> = listener_smtps; rebind that does nothing — it just renames the variable. This adds noise without adding clarity.

What needs to be done: Remove the rebind and use listener_smtps directly, or rename it at the binding site.
